title: 2016 AMC 10A Problem 9
statement: A triangular array of \(2016\) coins has \(1\) coin in the first row, \(2\) coins in the second row, \(3\) coins in the third row, and so on up to \(N\) coins in the \(N\)th row. What is the sum of the digits of \(N?\)

solutions.text:
Recall that the sum of the first \(N\) numbers is \(\dfrac{N(N + 1)}{2}.\)

We want to find \(N\) such that \[ \dfrac{N(N + 1)}{2} = 2016. \] Cross-multiplying and simplifying gives us \[ N^2 + N - 4032 = 0. \] Factoring gives us \[ (N - 63)(N + 64) = 0. \] We want the positive value so \(N = 63.\) Adding together the digits gives us \(9.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
